_comment: Verifies reaction_diffusion pitfall 5 on scikit-fem 12.0.1 (2026-08-06). ElementQuad1 4x4 (25 DOFs), dt=2e-4, gamma=1000, d_v = d_u so the uniform state is stable and the measurement isolates the (a,b) parameterisation. (1) The assembled reaction load at (a+b, b/(a+b)^2) is 9.8e-18, machine zero. (2) Swapping a and b in v_ss gives v0 = 0.1 instead of 0.9: peak |mean(u)-u_ss|/u_ss = 6.8e-01 and it takes 200 steps (T=0.04, ~40 reaction times) to fall back to 2.5e-05, against exactly 0.0 at every step for the correct start. (3) With b mistyped as 0.99 but the IC set to the believed (1.0, 0.9) the run settles at 1.0900009885 = a+b_typo, i.e. a 9.0001% deviation from the expected u_ss = 1.0 - the claim's diagnostic. Recorded side finding: with the SHIPPED (a,b) = (0.1,0.9), a+b = 1, so dropping the square in b/(a+b)^2 is undetectable (load stays 9.8e-18); at (a,b) = (0.05,1.0) the same typo gives 1.1e-02.
